frictions.description: VAL-RQ-006 assertion mentions detecting 'plan/debug section headings' but the bad-debugging-output.md fixture uses debugging language in body text rather than contamination section headings. The no_plan_contamination check passes on the debugging fixture because it only scans ## headings, not inline language. The debugging language is caught by the separate no_debugging_language criterion instead.
frictions.resolution: Both criteria together provide complete coverage — no_debugging_language catches inline debugging text while no_plan_contamination catches debug-style section headings.
